title: Cannes 2024
deck: Drawings of Cannes for Kodak's events at the festival.
lede: A year after the HollyShorts invitation, Kodak's events at Cannes got the same fine blue line: the town's streets and buildings, drawn for posters and invitations.
challenge: Kodak, a name built on film, hosted events at the 2024 Cannes Film Festival and needed original illustrations and poster design for them.
work: The illustrations draw Cannes in a light blue line, a street and a building at a time, loose enough to feel made on the spot and clean enough to print. They carried the events' posters and invitations, in the same hand as the HollyShorts invitation a year before.
credits: Dalton Corr: illustration and poster design
